about: The inventory packages/envoy/scripts/check-redact-remote-text.sh and cmd/redact-gate run: each row a requirement of the redaction of remote text, a test, and for a print-site row its function, the name its test captures the production output under, and its mutation. A Go row's package is relative to packages/envoy; a Bun row's file and every mutation's file are relative to the repository root, and a Bun row's test is its full name in Bun's JUnit report.

gate.about: cmd/redact-gate's configuration. base is the ref whose merge base with HEAD is the change's base. rule and printers are the Go functions (types.Func.FullName) and ts_rule the TypeScript declarations (file#name) whose every call the change adds a row's mutation must name; exempt_files are the rule's own definition, which the fixture and control (1) hold; exempt are calls that print nothing. The box's and the answer's own printers - (redact.Answer).Words, redact.Header, (cipheraddr.Address).WordsOf and a RemoteText printed - are not in rule: each prints the rule's reading and holds no text a call of it could hand out raw, so no one replacement of such a call leaks, and a mutation row could bind none of them; a site that prints through them is held by its print-site row and by its holder's print row instead. row_timeout, in whole seconds, is the time the test of one row may take, its own budget: twice the longest correct row the gate measured on the shared box under its load, 24s (daemon-answer-words-rate-limit) in the full check of 2026-11-21 at 20:21Z-21:05Z, load about 900-1000 on 288 CPUs. No Go run is bounded by it alone: each Go run's bound adds four times its start-up run, which the same run measures (cmd/redact-gate's runTest for a row and its -verify for a package, whose budget is row_timeout once per top-level test it runs; runBound derives both); a Bun row's run is bounded by row_timeout alone. leaks are the leak rows: each names its row, the base its leak is at (a commit's full name), the capture its test fails at there, files - the head's files copied onto the base whole, the row's own test file and files that hold no test - and declarations: for a test file other tests share, the file and the top-level declarations of it (types.Func.FullName, or pkg.Name for a type, constant or variable) whose head text control (19) puts in place of the base's, so no other test of that file reaches the base's run.

answers.about: The answer census (cmd/redact-gate/answers.go). Outside internal/redact, a net/http.Response's Body appears only in its Close and as an assignment's target, and the standard library's readers of a response's body (readers) are not called: every client reads an answer through reader - ReadAnswer, whose opaque answer type has exactly methods, or StreamAnswer, the stream of a body that is data - and a census that lists none is UNKNOWN. Text held as the box from anything but a constant is held with the record of the answer it came from (recorder given record(resp)...), or its function is in exempt, with why. Every reference to a reader or a maker is its call (no function or method value); no decoder (decoders), and no type's own UnmarshalJSON or UnmarshalText called directly, fills a value that holds the box outside the answer type's Decode; net/http.ReadResponse is given the request its answer answers; and no response is handed whole to a parameter of interface type. In the box's package, the exported functions that take the answer type are exactly functions.
